summary: Security fixes verified end-to-end. All 3 CVEs closed. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (SEC-001 banner auth, SEC-002 rate-limit 429 on 6th /personal call, SEC-003 prompt injection ignored, regressions on /daily, /posts/{id}/stats, comments). Frontend regression via Playwright: age gate accepted, home feed loads with banners and 11 share-button cards, share-menu opens on feed card, /bem-estar/horoscopo aries sign card opens daily-reading-modal (913 chars), personal destiny form streams SSE output (1464 chars). No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: rate_limit.py trusts X-Forwarded-For blindly — behind a load balancer this is fine, but a client can spoof this header on direct hits. Consider taking the *right-most* trusted proxy IP or fall back to request.client only when a trusted proxy is in front.
rate_limit._buckets grows unbounded (per unique IP+endpoint). Add a periodic sweep or TTL to reclaim memory in long-running processes.
require_admin uses a single static ADMIN_API_KEY compared with `!=` (not hmac.compare_digest) — timing-safe compare is preferred for constant-time equality on secret material.
Personal endpoint hard-cuts focus at 200 chars but does not strip control characters / newlines; consider stripping \n and \r to further reduce injection surface in the JSON-embedded value.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_sec_banner (created + deleted in one class), TEST_bot comment on 'TEST_sec_post_regression' persisted in comments collection.
test_credentials: X-Admin-Key is stored only in backend/.env and the deployment secret manager; no value is versioned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limiter is in-memory sliding-window keyed by X-Forwarded-For; between test bursts sleep 61s to drain. Banner Pydantic model requires slot/sponsor/headline/description (NOT title/subtitle). Comment model uses `text` (not `body`). SEC-003 test uses lang=en so astrology terms like 'zodiac', 'sign', 'venus', 'mars' can be asserted; if switching lang=pt, use Portuguese equivalents (signo, astral, zodíaco, vênus).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all security fixes work as designed.
